content.comment_body: Clarification needed regarding message text confirmation: For <Both> as the message destination and without ticker, on each line, the last four cells (positions 17 to 20) will not appear on [product_name], but will be displayed on [product_name] TDE. Is this accurate?
Yes, that's correct. The display on [product_name] supports 16 characters per line, while the TDE display allows for 20 characters per line, giving 4 extra characters.
